attacks.name: Plasma Blast
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Incinerate|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§incinerate§Incinerate| special condition.

attacks.name: Plasma Wave
steps: After each attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§incinerate§Incinerate| special condition.
|!wild| |*Pierce|: Change 1 of the defender's |!critical|, |!wild|, or |!block| results to a Blank.

superPowers.name: Government Sanctioned (Affiliation: X-Factor)
superPowers.body: During the |*Power Phase|, choose up to 3 allied characters. Each chosen character gains an X-Gene token. When an allied character is attacking or defending, if either the attacker or defender is holding or Contesting an objective token, that allied character may spend an X-Gene token during the |*Modify Dice| step. If it does, it rerolls up to 2 of its dice. At the end of the Round, remove all X-Gene tokens from allied characters.

superPowers.name: Blast Off
superPowers.body: Place this character within |!range| 2 of its current position. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Plasma Dispersion
superPowers.body: When this character makes an attack, it may change 1 die result to a |!hit| for each |!wild| in the attack roll.
